highlight.title: Cloud Run Billing Caps Coming Soon
highlight.summary: Google announced Cloud Run will soon support billing caps that automatically deactivate resources when monthly spend limits are reached. This addresses a major concern for developers worried about runaway costs from autoscaling serverless workloads.

resources.title: Secret Manager Cost Optimization Guide
resources.why_now: A developer's real story of an $84 secret version cleanup that dropped Secret Manager costs by 97% - essential reading for teams automating credential rotation on Cloud Run.

resources.title: BigQuery Fluid Scaling: 34% Cost Reduction
resources.why_now: BigQuery fluid scaling launched at Cloud Next '26 delivers automatic cost savings for autoscaling workloads without configuration changes - the most direct cost optimization Google announced.

resources.title: Cloud Run's New AI Agent Integration
resources.why_now: Cloud Run's MCP server integration and ephemeral storage features position it as the compute fabric for AI agents, fundamentally shifting from generic serverless to stateful agent workloads.

resources.title: GCP Secret Manager: Complete Security Tutorial
resources.why_now: Practical guide covering IAM roles, versioning gotchas, and GKE Workload Identity integration - fills the gap between basic tutorials and production-grade secret management patterns.

claude_take: The serverless landscape is consolidating around AI-first primitives, with Cloud Run billing caps addressing developers' biggest fear about serverless: unpredictable costs. Secret Manager's hidden cost traps and BigQuery's fluid scaling represent the maturation of GCP's cost controls - moving from reactive billing alerts to proactive spend management.
